text:
sophia.sales: Quick sync — CloudVertex co-launch kit is ready for initial pass (logos, 1-pager solution brief, two case study drafts, marketplace tile). Need design + legal eyes before we send to partner. Launch window target: 10 business days.

elaine.partnerships: Dropping assets in the drive now. Link: https://drive.redwood.example/CloudVertex-launch-kit-2026 (contains source SVGs + PNG exports + case drafts).

jordan.design: Got it. I pulled the hero lockups — one ask from CloudVertex: they require partner logo to stay on a white/neutral background, no overlay. Can we confirm hero treatment allowed? :eyes:

carlos.cloudvertex: confirmed — CloudVertex brand guidelines: no overlay, 16px clearspace minimum. Also prefer their blue (#0057B8) not be altered.

mike.marketing: Noted. Marketing: we need one 1-page co-branded solution brief (A4/PDF) + a shorter marketplace blurb (120 words) and a social tile. Who's owning the marketplace tile dimensions?

jordan.design: I'll create the PDF master + marketplace tile sizes. Quick check: preferred marketplace tile is 1200x600 for the cloud marketplace. Will export @2x for retina.

priya.legal: Heads up — client provided a trademark usage doc. Two legal items: (1) any customer quote used in the case study must be pre-approved by CloudVertex (they mentioned a 72-hour approval window). (2) we need partner sign-off on the co-brand badge and any joint trademark lockup. I can draft the approval email.

legal-bot: reminder: create "partner-asset-approval" task in Legal board with due date +72 hours when assets are uploaded.

sophia.sales: Thanks Priya. Let's call out the approval steps in the pull: 1) logos + lockup 2) case study customer quotes 3) marketplace tile copy 4) final PDF exports.

elaine.partnerships: Timeline proposal: Day 0 (assets in drive), Day 1 design pass, Day 2 internal marketing review, Day 3 legal upload + send to CloudVertex, Day 6 partner review complete, Day 7 final exports and marketplace publish. Does that align?

mike.marketing: That works for go/no-go, but we need one buffer day for translations/localization if partner asks. Add Day 8 optional.

jordan.design: Quick technical note — I saw two logo formats: `cloudvertex_logo_vert.svg` and `cloudvertex_logo_horz.svg`. Using the horizontal on the marketplace tile looks cleaner. Will attach a zip in the drive.

priya.legal: Also request: if we include partner case study metrics (e.g., "20% latency reduction"), add the metric source line and the measurement window — partners tend to ask for that.

carlos.cloudvertex: Fine with metrics as long as we use the agreed phrasing and include an attribution line. We'll reply in the partner approval thread when you send.

sophia.sales: Action items: Jordan — design masters + tile by end of day tomorrow. Mike — draft marketplace blurb + social copy. Priya — prepare approval email + legal task. Elaine — coordinate partner send and confirm CloudVertex's legal contact. I'll compile final checklist. :thumbsup:

jordan.design: On it. Uploading `CloudVertex_co-kit_v1.zip` in ~4h.

mike.marketing: Draft blurb pushed to drive under `/copy/marketplace-blurb.md`. Ask: tone — technical vs product? Leaning product-forward for marketplace.

sophia.sales: Product-forward is good — highlight reliability and cost per inference improvements.

priya.legal: I'll draft email now and paste here for review before sending to partner.

legal-bot: task created: `partner-asset-approval-2478904321` assigned to priya.legal, due 2478980000.

elaine.partnerships: One small constraint from CloudVertex: no customer logos on the solution brief without explicit customer consent. So case study should redact other vendor logos.

mike.marketing: Thanks — we'll remove external logos and replace with iconography.

sophia.sales: Perfect. If nobody objects, I'll schedule the partner send for Day 3 10:00am PT.

carlos.cloudvertex: OK for 10:00am PT. We'll review within the 72-hour window.

jordan.design: Uploaded ZIP and exported PNGs. Link: https://drive.redwood.example/CloudVertex-launch-kit-2026/CloudVertex_co-kit_v1.zip :rocket:

sophia.sales: Great work team. Follow-ups in thread.

mike.marketing: :eyes: will review copy tomorrow AM.
